actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item Tentacle]] attacks, uses [[/item Reel]], and makes two [[/item Bite]] attacks.

actions.name: tentacle
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. Hit: The target has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the grapple ends. The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has Grappled when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

actions.name: reel
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.
